title: Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage Repair and Claim Service Entitlements
content:
These are the repair, towing, storage, payment and special-item entitlements of each Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage deductible option.

## Entitlements that differ by option

| Deductible option | Towing from the loss scene, maximum miles | Aftermarket custom equipment limit (USD) | Pet injury limit (USD) | Original manufacturer parts for vehicles this many model years or newer |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Physical Damage $2,000 Deductible | 50 | 1000 | 500 | 0 (no requirement) |
| Cardinal Physical Damage $1,000 Deductible | 50 | 1000 | 500 | 0 (no requirement) |
| Cardinal Physical Damage $750 Deductible | 50 | 1500 | 1000 | 0 (no requirement) |
| Cardinal Physical Damage $500 Deductible | 50 | 1500 | 1000 | 2 |
| Cardinal Physical Damage $250 Deductible | 75 | 2500 | 1000 | 3 |
| Cardinal Physical Damage $100 Deductible | 100 | 5000 | 1000 | 5 |

## Entitlements common to every option

| Entitlement | Every deductible option |
|---|---|
| Storage charge paid, maximum per day | 45.00 USD |
| Storage paid through this many calendar days after the storage notice | 3 |
| Repair payment amount at or above which the loss payee is named jointly | 2500.00 USD |
| Supplement amount at or above which the supplement is reinspected before payment | 1500.00 USD |
| Workmanship warranty on repairs at a Cardinal Select Shop | Lifetime, while the vehicle is owned |
| Labor rate basis at a shop outside the Cardinal Select network | The prevailing competitive rate in the garaging area |
| Calibration of driver-assistance sensors after a covered repair | Paid |
| Loss in market value after repair (first-party diminished value) | Not paid |

## Meaning of the special-item limits

- **Aftermarket custom equipment limit**: the limit for aftermarket custom parts and equipment not included in actual cash value.
- **Pet injury limit**: the limit for veterinary expenses of a dog or cat injured in a covered collision.
- **Original manufacturer parts**: vehicles of the stated number of model years or newer are repaired with original manufacturer parts; 0 means the option carries no such requirement.

## Points of reading (hypothetical vehicles)

- A vehicle on the $250 option is towed from the scene: the option's towing figure is 75 miles, against 50 on the $500 option.
- A vehicle on the $750 option carries documented aftermarket equipment worth 2000: the option's limit for it is 1500.
- A supplement of exactly 1500.00 is at the reinspection figure; one of 1499.99 is below it.
